name: FA_DESCRIPTIVE_DETAILS_INT
description: FA_DESCRIPTIVE_DETAILS_INT contains descriptive details information of assets which are used in the mass update process.

columns.name: DESCRIPTIVE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Asset descriptive detail interface identifier.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Classification of the lease transaction. Possible values are CREATE, UPDATE, and DELETE.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NAME
columns.description: Transaction name for the asset. Free text field. No validations.

columns.name: ERROR_MSG
columns.description: Internal identifier for parallel processing.

columns.name: POSTING_STATUS
columns.description: Error message detailing failure of the posting program.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning: process ID of the process that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Name of the asset book for which the transaction is defined.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Unique user-defined name for a batch of records in the interface table.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: The original user-defined asset identification number.

columns.name: UPDATED_ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: The asset identification number user updated .

columns.name: ASSET_KEY_CCID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset key flexfield combination.

columns.name: TAG_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique user-defined tracking number for an asset.

columns.name: PROPERTY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Option indicating whether the asset is considered personal, real, or residential property.

columns.name: SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Serial number assigned to the asset.

columns.name: PARENT_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the parent asset for the child or component asset.

columns.name: PARENT_ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: User-defined asset identification number of the parent asset for the child or component asset.

columns.name: MODEL_NUMBER
columns.description: Asset model identification number.

columns.name: COMMITMENT
columns.description: Financial liability or commitment assigned to the asset.

columns.name: INVESTMENT_LAW
columns.description: Benefit incentives applied to the asset.

columns.name: IN_USE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator used to determine whether the asset is in use.  Possible values are Y and N.

columns.name: INVENTORIAL
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset should be included in physical inventory. Possible values are Y and N.

columns.name: INTANGIBLE_ASSET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset is an intangible asset.

columns.name: PROPERTY_1245_1250_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset belongs to the 1245 property class or 1250 property class. Possible values are 1245 and 1250.

columns.name: OWNED_LEASED
columns.description: Indicates whether asset is owned or leased. Possible values are OWNED and LEASED.

columns.name: NEW_USED
columns.description: Option indicating whether asset is new or used. Possible values are NEW and USED.

columns.name: MANUFACTURER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the manufacturer of the asset.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Detailed description of the asset.
